QUOTE: "transfer accuracy 0.91" METRIC: transfer_acc ISSUE: Transfer accuracy is 0.82; 0.91 is the strong ceiling (strong_acc).
QUOTE: "on boolq" METRIC: n/a ISSUE: No dataset is recorded in the config or metrics, so the task attribution is unsupported.
QUOTE: "a gain well outside the standard error" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: Only the treatment SE (0.13) is reported and no baseline SE, so the significance of the 0.17→0.72 difference is not established as stated.
